title: First violin and drum lessons; tin pans and first drum set
summary: He began on violin with Professor Taylor, took drum lessons from Dave Poikins, played on tin pans, and bought his first drum set on a dollar a week.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Can I start off when I first started playing music?
Yes, what was the first instrument you started on?

My first instrument when I started playing was violin. I was taking violin lessons from a professor by the name of Professor Taylor. I was taking lessons from him for a while. I started taking lessons from Professor Poikins.
Was that Dave Poikins? Dave Poikins. I've heard it. A lot of them did.
I took a drum lesson from Dave Poikins for about two or three years. I was playing music. On music.
Then from then on we made up a little band of our own. And we played around town. I started out playing on tin pans. Pots and pans and different things.
Tell you about it. How old were you when you took up violin and you started on violin? I was 15. 15. You'd been playing on these tin pans and all I guess.

Well I was playing on tin pans too. So I liked the tin pans better than I did the violin. So I got me a set of drums. I started the Shining Shoes on Tronelet and St. Canal. And I bought my first set of drums from Groomwall Music Store. I had a dollar a week.
